= Non-AsciiDoc Includes

This document tests the inclusion of non-AsciiDoc files.
The LSP server must handle these gracefully — they should appear in the include tree
but not be parsed as AsciiDoc.

== Java Source Include

The following includes a Java source file with tag filtering:

[source,java]
----
include::Example.java[tags=main]
----

== Full Java File

[source,java]
----
include::Example.java[]
----

== YAML Configuration

[source,yaml]
----
include::config.yaml[]
----

== PlantUML Diagram

[plantuml]
----
include::diagram.puml[]
----
